content.short: AhoraCrypto is a MiCA-licensed non-custodial onramp for buying 70+ cryptocurrencies.
content.description: AhoraCrypto sells crypto directly to a user's own wallet rather than holding balances, operating under a MiCA licence in the European Union. MiCA licensing has become a meaningful differentiator for European onramps, since it replaced a patchwork of national regimes that made cross-border operation awkward.
content.meta: Buy 70+ cryptocurrencies straight to your own wallet through a MiCA-licensed European onramp.
